checks.detail: tests/test_automation_resilience.py runs 31 tests with 0 failures on the locked runtime; seven new tests prove the stamp guard, drain quarantine before writes, analytics-only concentration (no capital/coverage writes), recent-candidate quarantine, and advisory-only concentration signals.

The T8 diff touches exactly the two owned files: a small stamp guard plus drain/recent-candidate wiring in autonomous_runner.py and ~230 lines of tests; no unrelated module, dependency, or forbidden path changed.

The quarantine raises before any candidate is appended or persisted through the runner path, and the drain loop starts no capital/coverage write; all tests run inside TemporaryDirectory so no repository state is mutated.

A 341-test regression run passes on the locked runtime, including the T8 focused module, campaign boundary CLI guards, capital projection, legacy harness quarantine, campaign controller, and the two-cycle integration suite.
Spec and quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN.

advisories.detail: _recent_candidates now fails closed on any unstamped entry rather than filtering it; a tolerant filter was rejected because silently dropping candidates could hide quarantine violations.
cycle_log writes and legacy scratch/report outputs remain untouched by this slice; they stay quarantined behind the T7 Campaign boundary for real execution paths.
